transformations.formula: Select FRA Form 54 rows whose Accident Cause Code is T109, the official buckled/sun-kink alignment code.
Remove only exact duplicate selected-field API rows; retain distinct events even when a railroad reused an accident number.
Aggregate 1975-2025 and exclude the four incomplete 2026 records from all scored totals.
Sum reported nominal damage, deaths and injuries without inflation conversion or monetizing casualties.
Normalize the one directly assessed country; records in all 50 states do not become global coverage.
0.35B + 0.30H + 0.20P + 0.15E; convert to 1-10 with 1 + 9 × composite and round to one decimal.

receipts.uncertainty: Form 54 includes reportable rail-equipment accidents above the applicable annual damage threshold, so minor buckles and operational heat restrictions without a reportable accident are absent. The T109 code includes buckled/sun-kink alignment but does not prove ambient heat was the sole cause of each record. Damage is nominal and not inflation-adjusted. Twenty-one exact duplicate selected-field rows were removed; distinct rows sharing an accident number were retained. The assessment covers one country and is not extrapolated globally.
receipts.freshness: FRA API updated 2026-07-27; scored accumulated record ends with complete calendar year 2025; snapshot reviewed 2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: FRA administrative records quantify buckled/sun-kink accidents, nominal damage, casualties, a 51-year persistence interval and one-country extent under an exact official cause code.
higher_priority_failures: The source covers the United States rather than a defensible current global aggregation.
The node contract includes heat restrictions as well as buckles, while Form 54 contains only reportable accidents above annual thresholds; current-data coverage is therefore incomplete.
